uk_eidc_fds_oregon.name: UK Environmental Information Data Centre (EIDC) Sycan Marsh Oregon FDS Simulations

audit_result.download_status: Successfully downloaded and extracted (52 KB zip, 206 KB .out, 37 KB .smv)
audit_result.scientific_classification: The FDS particle classes (1: grass, 2: shrub, 3: wood, 4: leaf) in this dataset represent stationary subgrid vegetative fuel elements derived from terrestrial LiDAR scans of a 40x40m plot. They govern boundary heat transfer, thermal pyrolysis, and fuel mass loss on the ground/canopy, NOT airborne firebrand trajectory transport. Unsuitable for airborne spotting validation.

audit_result.spatial_units: Reconstructed coordinate files rt_is.* store millimeters; converted strictly to SI meters in pipeline
audit_result.temporal_resolution: UNVERIFIED: Camera frame rate and time-step Delta t are not recorded in upstream repository files or calibration logs. Velocity cannot be independently validated without confirmed frame rate.
audit_result.limitations: Observation volume is limited to a small window (10.9 cm x 8.4 cm x 5.7 cm); embers exit camera field of view without landing; mass and projected area were not recorded for individual tracked particles; frame rate is unconfirmed.
